annotations: Complete ChIP-seq analysis for paired-end sequencing data. Processes raw FASTQ files through adapter removal (cutadapt), alignment to reference genome (Bowtie2), and stringent quality filtering (MAPQ >= 30, concordant pairs only). Peak calling with MACS2 optimized for paired-end reads identifies protein-DNA binding sites. Generates alignment files, peak calls, and quality metrics for downstream analysis.
name: ChIP-seq Analysis: Paired-End Read Processing
